class DownloadReminderTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.o = Organizer.objects.create(name='Dummy', slug='dummy')
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            self.event = Event.objects.create(
                organizer=self.o, name='Dummy', slug='dummy',
                date_from=now() + timedelta(days=2),
                plugins='pretix.plugins.banktransfer'
            )
            self.event.settings.ticket_download = True
            self.order = Order.objects.create(
                code='FOO', event=self.event, email='dummy@dummy.test',
                status=Order.STATUS_PAID, locale='en',
                datetime=now() - timedelta(hours=4),
                expires=now().replace(hour=12, minute=0, second=0) + timedelta(days=10),
                total=Decimal('46.00'),
                sales_channel=self.event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
            )
            self.ticket = Item.objects.create(event=self.event, name='Early-bird ticket',
                                              default_price=Decimal('23.00'), admission=True)
            self.op1 = OrderPosition.objects.create(
                order=self.order, item=self.ticket, variation=None,
                price=Decimal("23.00"), attendee_name_parts={'full_name': "Peter"}, positionid=1
            )
            djmail.outbox = []

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_disabled(self):
        send_download_reminders(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
        self.order.refresh_from_db()
        assert not self.order.download_reminder_sent

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_sent_once(self):
        self.event.settings.mail_days_download_reminder = 2
        send_download_reminders(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
        self.order.refresh_from_db()
        assert self.order.download_reminder_sent
        assert self.order.all_logentries().filter(action_type='pretix.event.order.email.download_reminder_sent').exists()

        send_download_reminders(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_sent_days(self):
        self.event.settings.mail_days_download_reminder = 1
        send_download_reminders(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
        self.event.settings.mail_days_download_reminder = 2
        send_download_reminders(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_not_paid(self):
        self.event.settings.mail_days_download_reminder = 2
        self.order.status = Order.STATUS_PENDING
        self.order.save()
        send_download_reminders(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_ticket_download_disabled(self):
        self.event.settings.mail_days_download_reminder = 2
        self.event.settings.ticket_download = False
        send_download_reminders(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_event_already_started(self):
        self.event.settings.mail_days_download_reminder = 2
        self.event.date_from = now() - timedelta(days=1)
        self.event.save()
        send_download_reminders(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_sales_channel_not_enabled(self):
        self.event.settings.mail_days_download_reminder = 2
        self.event.settings.mail_sales_channel_download_reminder = ['bar']
        send_download_reminders(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
        self.order.refresh_from_db()
        assert not self.order.download_reminder_sent

        # Once the sales channel is enabled, the reminder is sent in the next run
        self.event.settings.mail_sales_channel_download_reminder = ['web']
        send_download_reminders(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_attendees(self):
        self.event.settings.mail_days_download_reminder = 2
        self.event.settings.mail_send_download_reminder_attendee = True
        self.op1.attendee_email = 'attendee@dummy.test'
        self.op1.save()
        send_download_reminders(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 2
        assert {m.to[0] for m in djmail.outbox} == {'dummy@dummy.test', 'attendee@dummy.test'}

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_attendees_disabled(self):
        self.event.settings.mail_days_download_reminder = 2
        self.event.settings.mail_send_download_reminder_attendee = False
        self.op1.attendee_email = 'attendee@dummy.test'
        self.op1.save()
        send_download_reminders(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
        assert djmail.outbox[0].to == ['dummy@dummy.test']

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_attendee_same_as_buyer_not_sent_twice(self):
        self.event.settings.mail_days_download_reminder = 2
        self.event.settings.mail_send_download_reminder_attendee = True
        self.op1.attendee_email = 'dummy@dummy.test'
        self.op1.save()
        send_download_reminders(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
EOF
